redFlags.source: Autosport live text, Monaco GP race day, 29 May 2022: 'red flagged on lap 30 for Schumacher's crash', 'will restart at 5:15pm local time with a rolling restart', 'Lap 32 - and the safety car will come in at the end of it' (https://www.autosport.com/f1/live-text/f1-monaco-gp-live-commentary-and-updates-race-day-1114912/1114912/?p=2); J. Suttill, 'Massive Schumacher crash causes another Monaco GP stoppage', The Race, 29 May 2022: crash 'on lap 27 of the scheduled 77', red flag 'three laps later', 'another rolling restart' (https://www.the-race.com/formula-1/massive-schumacher-crash-causes-another-monaco-gp-stoppage); Wikipedia, 'List of red-flagged Formula One races' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_red-flagged_Formula_One_races): lap 30; Wikipedia, 2022 Monaco Grand Prix: 'resumed at 17:15 under the safety car with a second rolling start', 'three-hour time limit ... only 64 laps were completed' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Monaco_Grand_Prix)
redFlags.note: Jolpica: leader's lap 30 holds the stoppage (1283s), laps 31-32 behind the SC (158s, 124s). Scheduled distance: The Race says 77 laps; Wikipedia says 'scheduled to last for 78 laps' (the normal Monaco distance); 77 taken (the race started behind the SC). Race ended on the time limit after 64 laps.
